text:
ivy.sales: Luminar RFP incoming - heavy asks on HSM, EU-only residency, and a 3-week POC with 60k docs. Need SE + Security input.

mike.se: Quick take: 3-week POC + strict p95 <250ms likely needs Dedicated with reserved nodes. Also need vector purge SLA.

tasha.security: They list FIPS HSM for root keys and audit log export. Options: Private on-prem (full HSM) or Dedicated + partner HSM; must include rotation & audit SOPs.

owen.eng: Cost thumb: estimate ~$48k/mo for the Dedicated commit for POC, plus peering and egress. I'll add peering checklist (allowlist, PrivateLink, test harness).

sarah.solutions: I'll attach capability matrix and a short SOW template. Include rows: Region pinning, BYOK/HSM, retention policies, quantization, observable logs.

ivy.sales: Action items: Mike - draft KMS playbook + FAQ (EOD). Owen - finalize cost + peering checklist (tomorrow AM). Tasha - security bullets for RFP (tomorrow AM). Sarah - assemble attachments (tomorrow AM). upload-bot: file uploaded: capability_matrix_luminar.xlsx

ivy.sales: Will consolidate and send once KMS text is final.
